name: Bechorath
title: Ancestor of King Saul
summary: Bechorath was a man from the tribe of Benjamin and one of the ancestors of Israel's first king, Saul. He is mentioned in Saul's genealogy in 1 Samuel as the son of Beorah and the father of Zored. His significance lies primarily in his place in the genealogical line that led to King Saul.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Bechorath is mentioned as part of the genealogy of Saul, Israel's first king. He was the son of Beorah and the father of Zored in the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Bechorath belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, the smallest of the tribes of Israel, which nevertheless became the tribe that gave Israel its first king.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of Kish
keyEvents.description: Through his son Seror, and further through Abiel and Ner, Bekorat was an ancestor of Kish, who was Saul's father.

keyEvents.title: Saul's Royal Lineage
keyEvents.description: Bekorat's lineage culminated in Saul, who was anointed by the prophet Samuel to become Israel's first king.
